name: Launch

sources.title: Submit page — 'Please sign up to submit a product'

conditions: Free plan sits in a standard launch queue — 'Current queue estimate shown before submitting'
Free plan includes homepage listing, social promotion, newsletter feature, chosen launch date, and verified badge, but no guaranteed dofollow backlink
Pro ($39) adds a guaranteed high-authority backlink and skips the queue entirely
Account sign-up required (Google, GitHub, or email+password)
Maximum 1 launch per week across all plans
requirements: A product to launch — the platform targets 'vibe coders'/indie builders
Account via Google, GitHub, or email
preparation: Product name, URL, tagline/description, logo/icon, screenshots
Payment method (Stripe) only if choosing a paid tier
workflow: Sign up at https://trylaunch.ai/submit (Google, GitHub, or email)
Choose plan — Free is reachable via /submit?plan=free
Fill the launch form and pick a launch date
Free launches wait out the queue; Pro launches same-day
Product page goes live under /launch/<slug> and enters the homepage New Launches feed
watchFor: Default /submit CTAs steer to paid Pro/Grow — the free lane is the /submit?plan=free link
Grow ($199) is a directory-submission service, not a better listing
Pass ($99/yr) covers unlimited launches but the 1-launch-per-week cap still applies
countsAsLive: A public launch page exists at trylaunch.ai/launch/<slug> and the product appears in the New Launches feed
unknowns: Current length of the free launch queue
Whether free-tier outbound links are dofollow or nofollow
